title: Author-style registry (capability write-platform)
description: Split registry index for distilled author voices. Content lives in 06-ai-ops/write/author-styles/<slug>/ (COMMITTED, github-shared — reusable by every user of the repo, like wiki). registration != materialization: an author may be registered status:pending|planned before /write distill fills the artifact folder; status:installed requires STYLE.md + voice-card.md to exist (enforced by scripts/cross-tier/validate-write-registries.cjs).

slug.description: Unique slug; the value passed to --author-style=<slug>.

category.description: e.g. copywriting, marketing, fiction, essay, business.

one_line.description: One-line voice summary for the resolver/index.

status.description: planned = registered, not started. pending = distillation in progress. installed = artifact present (STYLE.md + voice-card.md required). deprecated = retired.

source_kinds.description: ref kinds the style was distilled from (books, articles, transcripts, urls).

distilled_on.description: ISO date of distillation, or null.

confidence.description: coarse self-reported fidelity of the distillation.
